raw_style.source_true: Two on readings, one from {first} and one from {second}, are my cue to choose {selected}.
raw_style.source_false: An off reading from either {first} or {second} is my cue to choose {other}.
raw_style.cases_prefix: Here are my decisions for the possible readings.
raw_style.rule: My usual choice is {other}. I make the exception and choose {selected} precisely when {first} and {second} both indicate on.
